verdict.rationale: telli documents call outcome fields and webhooks that POST call events, status changes, and outcomes to a configured endpoint, so outcome data is delivered after calls. Entity extraction is only implied by references to 'collected values' and saved appointments, and the payload schema is not shown. missing for 10: documented configurable extraction schema for entities/dispositions, webhook payload contents, API endpoint for retrieving per-call structured data, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can extract structured data from every call — outcomes, entities, dispositions — delivered via API or webhook after the call

citations.quote: Webhooks: Receive real-time notifications about call events, status changes, and outcomes.
When something happens on a call, telli sends a POST request to the endpoint you configure
Analyze individual calls, transcripts, and call outcome fields.
Choose SMS and WhatsApp workflow recipients from contact properties, collected values, or a fixed number
